youtube.title: Twiggy's Nature Colors! (ACHOO!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🌳 ACHOO! Twiggy the tree sneezed so hard that all the colors flew away! Can you help Twiggy find them?

Learn colors with Twiggy: RED, ORANGE, YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE and PINK! Twiggy visits the forest, the park, the pond, the sky and the farm, finds a red apple, an orange leaf, a yellow flower, a green frog, a blue bird and a pink pig, and you hear the REAL sounds of the frog, the bird and the pig. Then sing Twiggy's colors song, and stay till the end, because someone is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 6 colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and pink
✔️ Find colors in nature: apples, leaves, flowers and animals
✔️ Hear real animal sounds and see where animals live
✔️ Sing a happy colors song with Twiggy the tree!
